abstract: We develop an inter-temporal model to examine how financing choices influence firm innovation under asymmetric information. The framework incorporates R&D risk and adverse selection, whereby low-quality firms mimic high-quality innovators, generating endogenous screening and financing frictions. Firms choose among bank lending, equity financing, and hybrid financing based on asset composition, cash flow, and innovation risk. Bank lending mitigates moral hazard through collateral and liquidation, making it optimal for low-risk innovation but inefficient for high-risk R&D due to expected liquidation losses. Equity financing supports radical innovation through risk sharing but requires sufficiently high institutional quality to sustain investor participation. Hybrid financing combines these mechanisms and emerges as a response when firms face binding collateral or institutional constraints, expanding the feasibility frontier. Under high institutional quality, financing strategies follow a risk-dependent transition from bank lending to hybrid financing to equity financing. Under low institutional quality, firms that are excluded from external financing must reduce their innovation intensity unless financing constraints are relaxed. We further show that R&D subsidies are generally more effective than risk guarantees, as they relax financing constraints without weakening screening incentives. Our model yields testable predictions linking financing structure to firm characteristics, R&D risk, and institutional quality.
title: One size doesn't fit all: flexible financing as a catalyst for innovation
title_zh: 一刀切不可行：灵活融资作为创新的催化剂

abstract: The Affordable Care Act (ACA) significantly expanded health insurance in the United States, but its impact has varied across time and states. We assess the law’s heterogeneous impacts over the three presidential administrations since its enactment (between 2013 and 2023), as well as across states with different levels of implementation of the law. We focus on Medicaid expansion and Marketplace subsidies, including the enhanced subsidies under the American Rescue Plan of 2021 (ARP). We use national household survey data and a triple-difference design—leveraging variation by time, place, and income—to identify the coverage impacts of the key components of the law. We find that about 50% of ACA-related coverage gains between 2013 and 2023 came from Marketplace subsidies—about 40% from the original ACA subsidies and 10% from the ARP enhancements—while the remaining half were due to Medicaid, including from the "welcome mat" effect. Coverage gains differed substantially across presidential administrations, with Marketplace subsidies in particular proving more effective under Presidents Obama and Biden than under President Trump. The same subsidy amount was more than 1.5 times as effective in states running their own state-based Marketplaces than in states relying on the federal Marketplace, and this result is independent of state political ideology. Our findings highlight that while the ACA’s explicit economic features drive coverage gains, their effectiveness can be substantially enhanced or hindered through federal and state implementation.
title: The Rise and Fall (and Rise) of the Affordable Care Act: Varying Impacts on Coverage Over Time and Place
title_zh: 《平价医疗法案》的兴衰（与再兴）：覆盖影响随时间和地点的变化

abstract: This paper examines the relationship between income inequality and labour supply in China, with particular attention to low-income workers. Using China Family Panel Studies data for 2010–2020 and a fixed effects model, we assess associations with labour force participation and working hours. A one-percentage-point increase in the provincial Gini coefficient is associated with a 0.20-hour reduction in weekly working hours among low-income workers, compared with 0.13 hours among high-income workers. Evidence for labour force participation is limited, aside from a weak positive association among high-income individuals. Among low-income workers, the negative association is especially pronounced among self-employed, younger, highly skilled, and female workers. Results from the mechanism analyses are consistent with three potential channels: lower perceived opportunity fairness, weaker beliefs in social mobility, and a reorientation of cultural values away from material ambition. The moderation analysis further indicates that this negative association is stronger among low-income workers who perceive healthcare and social security problems as more severe, whereas perceived employment, education, and housing problems do not significantly moderate the relationship. These findings highlight the roles of psychological perceptions and cultural values in understanding how income inequality is related to labour supply among economically vulnerable workers. abstract: Agglomeration economy is the core driving force for urban development, and its externality provides space for policy intervention. China’s urban‑scale regulation policies mostly focus on the governance of negative agglomeration externalities, while paying insufficient attention to policies oriented towards the utilization of positive agglomeration externalities. This article constructs a spatial equilibrium model integrating positive agglomeration externalities to theoretically analyse the path selection of urban‑scale regulation policies. The research finds that the policy of fully internalizing agglomeration economy through wage subsidies is the theoretically optimal policy, as it can fully release the benefits of agglomeration economy and maximize social surplus. Without instruments to internalize agglomeration economy, the differentiated land development tax policy based on the gap between social marginal productivity and average productivity can guide the population to cities with high-level agglomeration economy and effectively control the excessive creation of new cities, thereby improving the utilization efficiency of agglomeration economy and social surplus. Therefore, it serves as a feasible suboptimal policy. The uniform development subsidy or tax policy that ignores the heterogeneity of urban agglomeration economy aggravates the imbalance of urban‑scale distribution through misaligned incentives or excessive constraints, making it an inferior policy. abstract: Carbon pricing and green subsidies are key instruments for industrial decarbonization, yet they may interact in unexpected ways. This paper examines their joint effects on technology choices in China’s steel sector using an evolutionary game model with three strategies – status quo, end-of-pipe, and breakthrough – and logit quantal response dynamics. The carbon price is endogenously determined by market clearing, generating a self-suppression effect: achieving a target price requires nominal stringency above that target. It also generates cross-crowding-out: transitional subsidies lower the carbon price, reducing breakthrough profitability. We derive three critical price thresholds governing transitions and establish monotonicity properties. Simulations show bounded rationality smooths jumps into S-shaped diffusion, and subsidy effectiveness depends on prevailing carbon prices. Carbon market structure affects policy costs. The results highlight the need to account for endogenous price feedback in policy mix design, offering insights for emissions-intensive industries. abstract: Export participation is a forward‐looking decision that involves large up‐front investments with back‐loaded returns. This implies that trade responds to expected future policy as well as current policy. The same observed policy change can trigger a wide range of responses depending on how transitory or persistent that change is expected to be, and trade responds to changes in expectations even when there are no observed changes in policy at all. This article combines empirical evidence with structural modelling to show that these lessons have important implications for how researchers interpret trade data and how policy makers should use trade policy to accomplish their objectives.
title: Credibility is trade policy

abstract: This paper examines bid requirements, where the government may cancel a procurement contract unless two or more bids are received. Using a first‐price auction model with endogenous entry, we compare the bid requirement and reserve price mechanisms in terms of auction failure and procurement costs. We find that, in comparison with bid requirements, reserve prices can reduce procurement costs and substantially lower failure probabilities, especially when entry costs are high or signals are sufficiently informative. Bid requirements are more likely to result in zero entry, while reserve prices can sustain positive entry under broader conditions.
title: Managing Procurement Auction Failure: Bid Requirements or Reserve Prices?

abstract: We study why US college graduation gaps by gender and race widened across cohorts. We develop a dynamic life‐cycle model with endogenous education, labor supply, marriage, fertility, and welfare participation. Preferences are fixed across cohorts and race/ethnic groups; changes arise from family background, labor‐market opportunities, and marriage markets. Labor‐market changes account for half of growth in women's graduation from the 1960 to 1980 cohorts. Parental background accounts for one quarter and marriage markets for one fifth. These shares are similar for Whites, Blacks, and Hispanics, but absolute gains were larger for White women, which led to wider racial gaps.
title: What Explains Growing Gender and Racial Education Gaps?

abstract: This study examines interval selection in the Pasture, Rangeland, and Forage Rainfall Index (PRF‐RI) program and evaluates how uniform premium subsidy rates affect optimal interval selections. Using South Dakota as a case study, we show a trend of increasing selection of nonproduction intervals from 2013 to 2024, raising concerns about program effectiveness. A mean–variance portfolio framework is used to identify optimal selection under profit‐maximizing and risk‐averse preferences, with and without subsidies. The results suggest that uniform premium subsidy rates can distort incentives and push producers toward selecting nonproduction periods, as taking more subsidies leads to higher expected net payouts.

abstract: Modern transportation has weakened the constraints of geographical distance on the flow of knowledge. This study investigates the impact of direct air connectivity on intercity collaborative innovation in China using theoretical models and a staggered DID approach. Utilizing data on newly established direct flights from 2003 to 2021, we find that such routes raise co-invented patents by about 20.4%, a larger effect than that reported for high-speed rail in existing literature. Based on the agglomeration economy micro-foundations, we identify three primary mechanisms: it (i) reduces frictions in inter-firm market integration, enhancing the sharing of suppliers, customers, and complementary resources; (ii) reinforces preferential matching with existing partners, improving collaboration efficiency; and (iii) expands the scope and direction of intercity knowledge flows, strengthening mutual learning and absorptive capacity. Further analysis reveals a potential crowding-out effect between high-speed rail and air travel within the 200–800 km range, suggesting modal competition in this intermediate distance band. Also, direct air routes promote the diffusion of innovation resources from stronger to weaker cities, forming a “strong‑leading-weak” pattern of collaborative innovation. Our findings suggest that enhancing air transport infrastructure helps reduce spatial disparities in innovation resources and reinforces the resilience of cross-regional innovation networks.

abstract: Research is a messy enterprise, fraught with dead ends and missed opportunities. When research is successful, intellectual property law offers market-driven rewards. When research is unsuccessful, however, the investment is treated as a waste—an unlucky gamble in the horse race of innovation. But failed research investments are not valueless. Instead, they generate useful information that increases the odds of success on subsequent research efforts. From a social perspective, then, firms should disclose information about research failures so that other firms can avoid duplicative, fruitless lines of inquiry. Unlike with successful research investments, however, firms have no easy opportunity to capture the value of information generated by their unsuccessful research. Indeed, the law offers no coherent approach for harvesting the social value of the information generated by failed research efforts. As a result, discoveries of what “does not work” are not optimally disclosed. In this paper, we develop a simple sequential-stage model to identify the shortcomings of this one-sided reward system. We explore possible legal and institutional solutions to the problem, focusing on informal bankruptcy alternatives, patent-like “propertization” mechanisms, and prizes. Our results shed light on the potential and limits of these mechanisms for aligning private and social incentives for research.
title: Rewarding failure
title_zh: 奖励失败

abstract: This paper studies how local threat shapes refugees’ cultural assimilation and economic integration, exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in their allocation across German regions between 2013 and 2016. Using representative survey data and administrative records, we measure cultural preferences alongside employment, earnings, and job characteristics, and build a threat index combining contemporaneous and historical local xenophobia. Refugees assigned to more hostile regions converge more rapidly to Germans’ stated preferences, yet do not find jobs faster and experience slower earnings growth. We show that local hostility heightens threat perceptions, prompting quicker cultural adoption, while higher discrimination slows refugees’ successful economic integration.
title: Threat and Assimilation: Evidence from Refugees in Germany*

abstract: A model of economic growth is presented in which workers increase their labour income by learning from higher-paid workers. They also experience individual random income shocks. A calibration of the model to U.S. wage micro data implies that these shocks are Brownian ‘noise’, with drift close to zero. Growth comes from occasional random advances at the frontier, which create novel learning opportunities for others and drive sustained growth. The long-run growth rate is increasing in both the variance of shocks and the knowledge-diffusion rate. The model closely reproduces the evolving shape of the U.S. wage distribution between 1991 and 2023.
title: Knowledge diffusion, rising inequality, and the dynamics of a pulled front

abstract: There is an ongoing debate about how to moderate toxic speech on social media and the impact of content moderation on online discourse. This paper proposes and validates a methodology for measuring the content-moderation-induced distortions in online discourse using text embeddings from computational linguistics. Applying the method to a representative sample of 5 million US political Tweets, we find that removing toxic Tweets significantly alters the semantic composition of content. The magnitudes of the distortions are comparable to removing 4 out of 67 topics from the online discourse at random. This finding is consistent across different embedding models, toxicity metrics, and samples. Importantly, we demonstrate that these effects are not solely driven by toxic language but by the removal of topics often expressed in toxic form. We propose an alternative approach to content moderation that uses generative Large Language Models to rephrase toxic Tweets, preserving their salvageable content rather than removing them entirely. We show that this rephrasing strategy reduces toxicity while mitigating distortions in online content.
title: The Content Moderator’s Dilemma: Removal of Toxic Content and Distortions to Online Discourse*

abstract: There is a large latent workforce in developing countries that consists of hundreds of millions of women who prefer to have paid work and yet are out of the labor force. Often, available job opportunities are incompatible with traditional gender roles that encourage women to stay at home. In a randomized experiment with 1,670 households, we partner with a jobs platform to offer short-term data work to women who are out of the labor force. We find three main results. First, flexible work-from-home jobs are highly effective at bringing women into paid work. Job flexibility more than triples take-up from 15% for an office job to 48% for a job that women can do from home while multitasking with childcare. Second, these jobs can act as a stepping stone to less flexible work. Trying paid work from home increases take-up of less flexible jobs two to three months later among women without previous work experience. “Gateway jobs” are especially important for women from more traditional households: their labor supply is more likely to be marginal to flexibility, and in turn, work experience shifts their attitudes to become less traditional. Third, from the labor demand side, remote work comes with trade-offs in worker performance. Working from the office increases accuracy by 3% and speed by 18%. However, these performance drawbacks of work-from-home arrangements may be outweighed by the increase in available workers.
title: Bringing Work Home: Flexible Work Arrangements as Gateway Jobs for Women in West Bengal*

abstract: We examine how culture information in job postings influences firms’ hiring outcomes. We utilize machine learning methods to measure five core values present in job postings and demonstrate that culture information helps attract job seekers, as it is associated with higher worker inflows. The effect strengthens when job seekers value culture in their job searches and face frictions in learning about culture from other sources. Additional analyses indicate that individual cultural dimensions in job postings are more salient to job seekers when they have heightened preferences for that particular value. Finally, culture information is associated with a higher likelihood that interviews result in offers, and greater acceptance of those offers. Overall, our results suggest that culture information in job postings helps job seekers sort into culturally aligned firms. This paper was accepted by Ranjani Krishnan, accounting. abstract: This study provides a rigorous empirical test for motivated memory as a cause for procrastination. In a longitudinal experiment over four weeks, individuals had to complete a cumbersome task of unknown length and receive noisy signals about their assigned workload. Varying scope for motivated memory results in more optimistic beliefs among workers who receive negative signals but not among those who receive positive ones. This suppression of negative news through motivated memory causes individuals to defer more work to the future. This paper was accepted by Marie Claire Villeval, behavioral economics and decision analysis. abstract: This paper examines how bank loans evolve following unexpected deposit flows. Using bank-level U.S. commercial banks' data, we show that while large banks' lending is largely unaffected, loans at small banks significantly change after deposit shocks. Furthermore, the extent of this change among small banks depends on their exposure to off-balance-sheet liquidity risk, proxied by the level of unused commitments. Small banks with higher off-balance sheet exposures tend to extend fewer new loans following positive deposit shocks, suggesting that liquidity absorbed from the failure of other banks or market disruptions might not as easily be lent again to borrowers. Overall, these findings emphasize how off-balance-sheet risks can constrain the credit supply channel, even in the presence of liquidity surpluses.

abstract: Ensuring food safety is paramount to global public welfare, yet information asymmetry poses a fundamental challenge. Existing studies largely explain disclosure from external and internal governance perspectives, but rarely focus on firms’ own food safety status. Signalling theory and legitimacy theory predict opposite disclosure motivations, making it difficult to explain why voluntary disclosure differs across varying food safety conditions. In contexts of constrained regulatory resources and potential strategic information manipulation, elucidating how food safety status influences voluntary disclosure is crucial for effective regulation and corporate sustainability. The empirical results show that there exists a significant U-shaped relationship between food safety status and voluntary food safety information disclosure. Performance pressure significantly moderates the U-shaped relationship, flattening the curve and narrowing the disclosure gap between firms with different safety performance. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that the influence of food safety status on voluntary food safety information disclosure exhibits heterogeneous effects across behaviour and strategy, industry attributes, social attention, and belonging region. Regulating voluntary disclosure can enhance transparency and market legitimacy. This study provides an operational paradigm for China and offers lessons for other developing countries.

abstract: This study examines the persistent effects of China's Modern Distance Education Program (MDEP), a large‐scale educational technology initiative that provided access to high‐quality instruction for over 100 million rural primary and junior high school students. Utilising two nationally representative surveys and employing a cohort‐based triple‐difference (DDD) identification strategy, we demonstrate that MDEP significantly narrowed the gender gap in educational attainment. The programme's effects exhibit a cumulative pattern, intensifying with greater exposure duration and investment intensity. We further find that MDEP facilitated gender‐equitable access to public educational resources and weakened son‐preference distortions in household educational investment, thereby improving educational outcomes for rural girls. These educational gains also translated into persistent reductions in gender disparities in labour market outcomes, with MDEP‐exposed rural women experiencing greater improvements in formal employment, digitally intensive occupations and wages than comparable men.

abstract: Previous literature on the determinants of entrepreneurship has not explored the role of social pension. Leveraging variation in the roll-out timing of a universal rural pension program across Chinese counties, our analysis, at both the individual and aggregate levels, reveals that pension provision led to an increase in entrepreneurship among the younger generation. We show that this effect operates through two primary channels: an intergenerational transfer channel and a local demand channel. Specifically, the pension program mitigates upward transfers from adult children to elderly parents, while boosting local consumer demand, which exerts a demand-side “pull” effect on enterprise establishment. Our findings may shed new light on the interplay between pension, intergenerational resource allocation, and entrepreneurial activity.
abstract_zh: 以往关于创业决定因素的研究文献尚未探讨社会养老金的作用。本文利用中国各县农村普惠性养老金项目推广时间上的差异，在个体和总体两个层面进行分析，发现养老金供给促使年轻一代的创业活动增加。我们表明，这一效应通过两个主要渠道发挥作用：代际转移渠道和本地需求渠道。具体而言，养老金项目减轻了成年子女向年长父母的上行转移，同时提振了本地消费需求，从而对企业创立产生需求侧的“拉动”效应。我们的发现可能为养老金、代际资源配置与创业活动之间的相互作用提供新的启示。

abstract: Recursive utility functions are often defined implicitly, as the solution of a functional equation known as the Koopmans recursion. As conditions for a unique solution can be demanding, and uniqueness itself has proven restrictive in some applications, I investigate the existence of a least and greatest solution, both of which possess a number of attractive properties. While a least solution can be shown to exist in great generality, I show that a greatest solution need not. I then identify a sufficient condition for the existence of a greatest solution, which imposes a minimal form of discounting on preferences. The condition is shown to be necessary whenever the greatest solution is computable by standard iterative methods.
abstract_zh: 递归效用函数通常以隐式方式定义，即作为被称为Koopmans递归的函数方程的解。由于唯一解的条件可能相当苛刻，且唯一性本身在一些应用中已被证明具有限制性，我考察了最小解与最大解的存在性，二者均具有若干吸引人的性质。尽管最小解可在相当一般的条件下被证明存在，但我表明最大解未必存在。随后，我识别出最大解存在的一个充分条件，该条件对偏好施加了一种最低形式的贴现。当最大解可通过标准迭代方法计算时，该条件被证明是必要的。

abstract: Under successive monopoly, how far can the retail price rise above the integrated monopoly price when only demand curvature is known? We work with α -concave demand: demand whose α -th power is concave, with log-concavity as the case α = 0 . Demands whose α -th power, or logarithm when α = 0 , is affine (the α -affine demands) yield the ratio ( 2 + α ) / ( 1 + α ) , but it is not tight: the manufacturer’s optimal wholesale price can strictly exceed the integrated monopoly price. The tight bound r ∗ ( α ) solves an explicit equation and is approached, never attained, by smoothed truncated α -affine demands; approximately 3.15 for log-concave and 1.71 for concave demand.
abstract_zh: 在连续垄断下，当仅知需求曲率时，零售价格能在多大程度上高于一体化垄断价格？我们研究α-凹需求：其α次幂为凹的需求，其中对数凹性对应α=0的情形。若需求的α次幂（当α=0时为对数）为仿射的（即α-仿射需求），则比值为(2+α)/(1+α)，但该界并不紧：制造商的最优批发价格可以严格超过一体化垄断价格。紧界r*(α)由一个显式方程解出，并可由平滑截断的α-仿射需求逼近，但永远无法达到；对数凹需求下约为3.15，凹需求下约为1.71。
title: Distribution-free bounds on double marginalization under α-concave demand
title_zh: α-凹需求下双重边际化的无分布界

abstract: Prior research shows that firms respond to cost pressures by absorbing the costs or passing them through to customers. I show that firms can also respond by managing their cash conversion cycle through adjusting trade credit policies. Longer payment terms are a form of financing subsidy such that firms can recapture the subsidy by adjusting collection from customers and payment to suppliers. I document that cost pressure is associated with shorter cash conversion period, primarily driven by increasing accounts payable days. The results generally do not vary depending on firms’ choice to absorb costs or pass them through to customers.
abstract_zh: 既有研究表明，企业会通过吸收成本或将其转嫁给客户来应对成本压力。本文表明，企业还可以通过调整商业信用政策来管理其现金转换周期，以此作为应对方式。较长的付款期限是一种融资补贴形式，企业可以通过调整对客户的收款和对供应商的付款来收回这一补贴。本文记录发现，成本压力与更短的现金转换周期相关，这主要由应付账款周转天数增加所驱动。这些结果通常不因企业选择吸收成本还是将其转嫁给客户而有所不同。
title: Cost pressure, cash cycle, and trade credit
title_zh: 成本压力、现金周期与商业信用

abstract: Financially constrained firms emit more per unit of output, yet standard production models need not reproduce this pattern. We develop a heterogeneous-firm model with collateral constraints, combining post-production abatement or clean-capital substitution with capital- or output-based emissions. With proportional output-based emissions, tighter financing raises intensity locally only for constrained firms that actively abate; clean-capital substitution leaves it constant. Under linear capital-based emissions, post-production abatement produce opposite pattern for low-net-worth firms; clean-capital substitution matches the pattern locally only when the cleaner capital mix reduces intensity more than production expansion raises it. Our results provide guidance for quantitative green-transition models with financial frictions.
abstract_zh: 受融资约束的企业单位产出排放更高，然而标准生产模型未必能再现这一模式。我们构建了一个包含抵押约束的异质性企业模型，将生产后减排或清洁资本替代与基于资本或产出的排放相结合。在按产出比例排放的情形下，融资收紧仅在积极减排的受约束企业内部提高排放强度；清洁资本替代则使其保持不变。在基于资本的线性排放情形下，生产后减排对低净值企业产生相反的模式；清洁资本替代只有在更清洁的资本组合降低强度的幅度超过生产扩张提高强度的幅度时，才能在局部匹配该模式。我们的结果为包含金融摩擦的量化绿色转型模型提供了指引。
title: Emission intensity in models with production under financial frictions
title_zh: 金融摩擦下生产模型中的排放强度

abstract: Scientific publication represents an observable form of selective knowledge disclosure through which firms signal capabilities, access knowledge networks, and attract talent. Building on the literature linking sectoral openness to productivity growth, we examine whether firms’ propensity to publish scientific work amplifies the productivity returns to R&D investment. We find that adopting an open-sourcing strategy is positively associated with labor productivity among R&D-intensive firms, controlling for unobserved heterogeneity at the firm and sector level, hence controlling for technology. This result is consistent with theories emphasizing the role of knowledge diffusion and absorptive capacity for firm performance. Methodologically, the paper extends the Hausman–Taylor-type approach for the identification of time-invariant variables in a fixed effect framework. Monte Carlo simulations show that this approach reliably identifies the impact of these regressors on productivity.
abstract_zh: 科学出版物是一种可观察的选择性知识披露形式，企业借此传递能力信号、获取知识网络并吸引人才。在将部门开放度与生产率增长相联系的文献基础上，我们考察企业发表科学成果的倾向是否会放大研发投资的生产率回报。我们发现，在控制企业和部门层面不可观测异质性从而控制技术因素后，采用开源策略与研发密集型企业更高的劳动生产率正相关。这一结果与强调知识扩散和吸收能力对企业绩效作用的理论相一致。在方法上，本文扩展了Hausman–Taylor型方法，用于在固定效应框架中识别时不变变量。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，该方法能够可靠地识别这些回归变量对生产率的影响。
title: Open-sourcing, labor productivity, and the moderating role of R&D
title_zh: 开源、劳动生产率与研发的调节作用

abstract: Enhancing grain production efficiency (GPE) is critical for ensuring food security and promoting a more resource-efficient agricultural transformation, particularly in smallholder systems where conventional machinery faces scale and terrain constraints. China’s rapid adoption of agricultural Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) offers an opportunity to assess whether digital machinery can improve efficiency without relying on farm expansion. Yet evidence on how UAV use intensity affects GPE, and on the conditions under which gains emerge, remains limited. Using data from 2,030 grain-producing households across nine provinces in the 2022 China Rural Revitalisation Survey, we measure GPE using a super-efficiency slacks-based measure model and estimate the effects of UAV use intensity. The results show a significant U-shaped relationship between UAV use intensity and GPE, with efficiency gains emerging only after UAV use intensity exceeds a certain threshold. UAV use affects GPE primarily through labour substitution and is nonlinearly associated with pesticide inputs. Besides, village-level agricultural service organisations strengthen the positive effects of UAV use, indicating that service provision complements the use of technology. The efficiency effects are stronger in western China and rice production systems, where conventional machinery is relatively constrained. These findings suggest that the benefits of agricultural UAVs depend not simply on adoption, but on sufficiently intensive use and supportive service institutions. Policies that expand access to UAV services and promote their effective integration into farm operations can improve factor allocation and grain production efficiency, especially in areas where conventional mechanisation is less adaptable. More broadly, these efforts can support agricultural digitalisation and sustainable agricultural modernisation.
abstract_zh: 提升粮食生产效率（GPE）对于保障粮食安全和推动资源节约型农业转型至关重要，尤其是在常规机械面临规模与地形约束的小农体系中。中国农业无人机（UAV）的快速采用，为评估数字机械能否在不依赖农场规模扩张的情况下提升效率提供了契机。然而，关于无人机使用强度如何影响GPE以及在何种条件下产生增益的证据仍然有限。本文使用2022年中国乡村振兴调查中九个省份2030个粮食生产农户的数据，采用超效率松弛测度（super-efficiency slacks-based measure）模型测度GPE，并估计无人机使用强度的效应。结果表明，无人机使用强度与GPE之间存在显著的U型关系，只有当无人机使用强度超过一定阈值后，效率增益才会显现。无人机使用主要通过劳动替代影响GPE，并与农药投入呈非线性关联。此外，村级农业服务组织强化了无人机使用的正向效应，表明服务供给对技术使用具有互补作用。效率效应在中国西部和水稻生产体系中更强，这些地区常规机械相对受限。这些发现表明，农业无人机的效益不仅取决于是否采用，还取决于是否足够密集地使用以及是否有支持性服务制度。扩大无人机服务可及性并促进其有效融入农场经营的政策，可以改善要素配置和粮食生产效率，尤其是在常规机械化适应性较弱的地区。更广泛而言，这些努力可以支持农业数字化和可持续农业现代化。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Does Agricultural Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Use Improve Grain Production Efficiency? Evidence from Rural China
title_zh: 农业无人机使用是否提升了粮食生产效率？——来自中国农村的证据

abstract: The structure of the Social Security program presents a trade-off between benefit duration and size; individuals who claim early receive lower monthly payments. Surprisingly, even wealthy Americans with high life expectancies frequently claim benefits at the earliest eligibility age, a behavior inconsistent with conventional life-cycle theory predictions. In fact, there is a striking similarity in claiming ages across groups with vastly different life expectancies, wealth levels, and incentives to delay. This paper resolves this puzzle by introducing policy details and subjective beliefs about longevity and program rules into a rich, forward-looking life-cycle model. When included in the model, subjective beliefs substantially narrow the claiming-age gaps across education (college vs. non-college) and marital-status (married vs. single) groups. Specifically, differences in program beliefs alone account for 48.6% of the education claiming age gap and 75.1% of the marital status gap. Counterfactual policy simulations demonstrate that failing to account for these claiming mechanisms dramatically overstates individual responses to an increase in the normal retirement age and understates the resulting fiscal savings.
abstract_zh: 社会保障项目的结构在福利持续时间与规模之间形成了一种权衡；提前领取者每月获得的给付较低。令人意外的是，即便是预期寿命较长、富裕的美国人，也常常在最早具备资格的年龄就申领福利，这一行为与传统的生命周期理论预测并不一致。
title: Revisiting Retirement and Social Security Claiming Decisions
title_zh: 重新审视退休与社会保障申领决策

abstract: We construct a new high-frequency measure of risk appetite shifts around Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings, the common component of changes in risk-sensitive indicators. Fed policy actions and communication have substantial effects on risk appetite. Interest-rate surprises explain only about one-fifth of the variation in risk appetite, so most policy-induced changes in risk asset prices are orthogonal to the expected rate path. We therefore use both surprises as external instruments in a proxy SVAR with two separately identified shocks. Risk appetite shocks have large and persistent contractionary effects, lowering output and prices while raising unemployment. By contrast, the effects of risk-free rate shocks tend to be small and imprecisely estimated, and some have puzzling signs. Monetary transmission appears to operate primarily through risk appetite and risk asset prices. Estimates relying on interest-rate surprises alone miss most of these effects, for two reasons: the link from interest rates to risk appetite is state-dependent, and Fed communication moves it independently of the expected rate path.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个新的高频指标，用以衡量联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）会议前后风险偏好的变动，即风险敏感指标变化的共同成分。美联储的政策行动和沟通对风险偏好具有显著影响。利率意外仅能解释风险偏好变动的约五分之一，因此政策引发的风险资产价格变化大多与预期利率路径正交。据此，我们在代理结构向量自回归（proxy SVAR）中将两种意外同时用作外部工具，并分别识别出两种冲击。风险偏好冲击具有显著且持久的紧缩效应，会降低产出和价格，同时推高失业率。相比之下，无风险利率冲击的影响往往较小且估计不精确，部分结果还呈现出令人费解的符号。货币传导似乎主要通过风险偏好和风险资产价格发挥作用。仅依赖利率意外的估计会遗漏其中大部分效应，原因有二：利率与风险偏好之间的联系具有状态依赖性，且美联储沟通会在预期利率路径之外独立地推动风险偏好。
title: Risk Appetite and Monetary Transmission
title_zh: 风险偏好与货币政策传导

abstract: Employee referrals may reinforce occupational gender segregation, but gendered referrals could simply reflect the composition of workers’ networks. We test whether incumbents also make gendered choices among available candidates in a two-part incentivized field experiment with 1, 294 skilled workers across 12 manufacturing and service occupations in Uganda. In Part I, respondents choose whom to refer for real six-week internships at their workplace from profiles in which candidate gender and post-training experience are cross-randomized. Because candidates enter respondents’ choice sets by design, availability and qualifications are held fixed. Gender non- congruent (GNC) candidates—whose gender does not match the occupation’s majority—are 23.4 percentage points less likely to be referred than gender-congruent candidates. In Part II, respondents nominate candidates from their own networks. These networks are gender-segregated, confirming that availability matters; yet among respondents naming contacts of both genders, GNC contacts are 26.2 percentage points less likely to be referred. Candidate evaluations suggest that the penalty reflects incumbents’ own beliefs and preferences, not only anticipated employer behavior. GNC candidates are rated lower as potential coworkers and less likely to be retained; within expected retention, the largest gap is in perceived task ability, exceeding those in anticipated employer valuation and candidate job enjoyment. With additional experience, evaluations of men entering female-dominated occupations reach or exceed a less-experienced GC baseline, while experienced women entering male-dominated occupations remain heavily penalized on task ability and enjoyment. Across calibrations, a dynamic network model incorporating the experimental referral weights implies that the choice penalty meaningfully amplifies occupational segregation. Expanding cross-gender networks alone may therefore leave an important barrier in place.
abstract_zh: 员工推荐可能强化职业性别隔离，但性别化的推荐也可能只是反映了劳动者网络的构成。我们在乌干达针对12种制造和服务职业的1，294名技能劳动者开展了一项分为两部分的激励性实地实验，以检验在职者是否也会在可获得的人选中做出性别化选择。在第一部分，受访者从候选人性别与培训后经历交叉随机化的档案中，选择推荐谁到其工作场所参加真实的为期六周实习。由于候选人按设计进入受访者的选择集，可获得性和资格条件被固定。性别不一致（GNC）候选人——其性别与职业中的多数性别不匹配——被推荐的可能性比性别一致候选人低23.4个百分点。在第二部分，受访者从自己的网络中提名候选人。这些网络存在性别隔离，证实了可获得性确实重要；然而，在提名了两种性别联系人的受访者中，GNC联系人被推荐的可能性低26.2个百分点。候选人的评价表明，这种惩罚反映了在职者自身的信念和偏好，而不仅仅是预期的雇主行为。GNC候选人作为潜在同事的评价更低，也更不可能被留用；在预期留用方面，最大的差距在于感知的任务能力，超过预期雇主评价和候选人工作享受方面的差距。随着经验增加，对进入女性主导职业的男性的评价达到或超过经验较少的性别一致基线，而进入男性主导职业的有经验女性在任务能力和工作享受方面仍受到严重惩罚。在不同校准下，一个纳入实验推荐权重的动态网络模型意味着，这种选择惩罚会显著放大职业隔离。因此，仅扩大跨性别网络可能仍会留下一个重要障碍。
title: Who You Know, Who You Recommend: Referrals and Occupational Gender Segregation
title_zh: 你所认识的人，你所推荐的人：推荐与职业性别隔离

abstract: After years of schooling, young adults in many countries enter labor markets that are di!cult to navigate, often leading to discouragement and underutilization of human capital. Can workers a few steps ahead help them navigate this critical juncture? To study this question, we designed and randomized Meet Your Future among vocational students transitioning from school to work. The program connects students with workers successfully employed in the study sector for one-on-one mentoring sessions. Three months after graduation, mentored students are 15 percent more likely to work, more likely to hold jobs in the study sector, and 27 percent less likely to exit the labor force. While there are no short-run earnings gains, mentored students earn 18 percent more one year later and experience more stable and steeper employment trajectories. Using rich survey data and transcripts from mentor–mentee calls, we show that mentorship works not by expanding job networks or changing job search intensity or effectiveness but by combining belief updating with encouragement. Mentored students lower reservation wages for entry-level jobs while maintaining a positive outlook about medium-run earnings. As a result, they accept lower-paying first jobs, start working sooner after graduation, and accumulate sector-relevant experience that accelerates progression along the job ladder. The results highlight the power of encouragement paired with realistic feedback and point to mentorship as a scalable complement to workforce development programs.
abstract_zh: 在许多国家，年轻人在完成多年学业后进入难以驾驭的劳动力市场，这往往导致其丧失信心并造成人力资本利用不足。领先几步的劳动者能否帮助他们度过这一关键节点？为研究这一问题，我们在从学校过渡到工作的职业院校学生中设计并随机实施了“遇见未来”项目。该项目将学生与研究领域内成功就业的劳动者配对，进行一对一导师辅导。毕业三个月后，接受辅导的学生就业可能性高出15%，更有可能在研究领域内找到工作，退出劳动力市场的可能性低27%。尽管短期内没有收入增长，但接受辅导的学生在一年后收入高出18%，并经历更稳定、更陡峭的就业轨迹。利用丰富的调查数据和导师—学员通话记录，我们表明，导师辅导的作用并非通过扩展求职网络或改变求职强度或效率来实现，而是将信念更新与鼓励相结合。接受辅导的学生降低了入门级工作的保留工资，同时对中期收入保持积极预期。因此，他们接受起薪较低的第一份工作，毕业后更快开始工作，并积累与行业相关的经验，从而加速在职业阶梯上的晋升。研究结果凸显了鼓励与切合实际的反馈相结合的力量，并表明导师辅导可作为劳动力发展项目的可扩展补充。
title: Meet Your Future: Experimental Evidence on the Labor Market Effects of Mentors
title_zh: 遇见你的未来：导师对劳动力市场效应的实验证据

abstract: Few heterogeneous-firm models are calibrated to firms' responses to income shocks because estimates of these responses are lacking. We estimate the average marginal propensity to invest (MPI) of firms in the US, that is, the share of a transitory sales shock that firms use for investment. In Compustat data, the dynamics of firms' sales are well described by a transitory-permanent process, so a semi-structural approach can identify the response of investment to transitory sales shocks. This response is statistically significant and the average MPI is 0.22. Younger firms, smaller firms, and non-dividend-paying firms exhibit significantly higher MPIs. Given that Compustat over-represents older and dividend-paying firms, our result is a lower bound on the response over the universe of firms. Our heterogeneity analyses make it possible to infer results for other sets of firms.
abstract_zh: 少数异质性企业模型之所以未能校准至企业对收入冲击的响应，是因为缺乏对这些响应的估计。我们估计了美国企业的平均边际投资倾向（MPI），即企业将暂时性销售冲击用于投资的比例。在Compustat数据中，企业销售的动态可由暂时性—永久性过程很好地描述，因此半结构方法能够识别投资对暂时性销售冲击的响应。这一响应在统计上显著，平均MPI为0.22。较年轻的企业、规模较小的企业以及不支付股利的企业表现出显著更高的MPI。鉴于Compustat对较年老和支付股利企业的过度代表，我们的结果是对全体企业响应程度的下界。我们的异质性分析使得推断其他企业集合的结果成为可能。
title: Firms’ Marginal Propensities to Invest
title_zh: 企业的边际投资倾向

abstract: Immigration continues to shape the economic and political debate in the United States. Yet, we surprisingly know little about the impact of immigration on the economic mobility of native children. Using recent data on changes in mobility and an identification strategy based on initial settlement patterns of immigrants, I study whether the large increase in the immigrant population between 1980 and 2010 had an impact on native intergenerational mobility. Despite concerns about immigration hurting native children, I find that the impact of immigration on native mobility is statistically insignificant. Moreover, I can rule out economically large effects. I show that this result can be explained by the insignificant impact of immigration on socioeconomic mechanisms previously associated with intergenerational mobility, such as parental employment or incarceration rates.
abstract_zh: 移民持续塑造着美国的经济与政治辩论。然而，令人意外的是，我们对移民如何影响本土儿童的经济流动性知之甚少。利用近期关于流动性变化的数据，以及基于移民初始定居模式的识别策略，我研究了1980年至2010年间移民人口的大幅增长是否对本土代际流动性产生了影响。尽管有人担忧移民会损害本土儿童的利益，但我发现移民对本土流动性的影响在统计上并不显著。此外，我可以排除具有经济意义上较大影响的可能。我进一步表明，这一结果可由移民对先前与代际流动性相关的社会经济机制——如父母就业或监禁率——影响不显著来解释。
title: JUE Insight: Immigration and native intergenerational mobility in the United States
title_zh: JUE洞察：美国移民与本土代际流动性

abstract: The pork cycle exhibits persistent oscillations in prices and production with a wavelength of three to six years. We develop a system dynamics model in which cyclical behaviour arises endogenously from biological delays and a simple adjustment rule, without the explicit modelling of price or forward-looking optimization from decision-makers. The model reproduces the cyclical component of Dutch pork prices, matching its wavelength and turning points, and explains the gradual shortening of the cycle through technological changes that reduced production lead times. Sensitivity analysis further separates the parameters that govern the cycle’s wavelength from those that govern its amplitude, and identifies policy levers acting on each. Our findings do not imply that prices are irrelevant; rather, they highlight that a significant part of the pork cycle is structural, with prices primarily reflecting underlying production delays. This perspective complements rational-expectations models and clarifies why similar ‘pork cycle’ patterns appear in other industries with long lead times.
abstract_zh: 猪肉周期在价格和产量上表现出持续振荡，波长为三至六年。我们构建了一个系统动力学模型，其中周期性行为由生物学延迟和简单的调整规则内生地产生，而未显式建模价格或决策者的前瞻性优化。该模型再现了荷兰猪肉价格的周期性成分，与其波长和转折点相匹配，并解释了通过缩短生产提前期的技术变革所导致的周期逐渐缩短。敏感性分析进一步区分了决定周期波长的参数与决定其振幅的参数，并识别出分别作用于二者的政策杠杆。我们的发现并不意味着价格无关紧要；相反，它们强调猪肉周期的很大一部分是结构性的，价格主要反映潜在的生产延迟。这一视角补充了理性预期模型，并阐明了为何在其他具有长提前期的行业中也出现类似的“猪肉周期”模式。
title: Breeding delays determine the wavelength of the pork cycle
title_zh: 繁殖延迟决定猪周期的波长

abstract: We study how the legal profession manages representational conflicts of interest. These conflicts arise when a single law firm represents clients with opposing interests, threatening to undermine the legal process and, ultimately, social welfare. We argue that current ethical standards, emphasizing disqualification, may actually worsen the clients’ situation. Instead, the clients’ interests are today mainly safeguarded by law firms being small, reducing the incidence of conflicts. Despite low market concentration, law firms enjoy high earnings as representational conflicts create negative network externalities at the firm level. These profits are sustained in the long run as entry occurs through firm split-ups.
abstract_zh: 我们研究法律行业如何管理代理利益冲突。当一家律师事务所同时代理利益对立的客户时，便会产生此类冲突，进而可能损害法律程序，并最终损害社会福利。我们认为，当前强调取消代理资格的伦理标准，实际上可能使客户的处境恶化。相反，如今客户利益主要依靠律师事务所规模较小、从而降低冲突发生概率来得到保障。尽管市场集中度较低，律师事务所仍享有高额收益，因为代理冲突在事务所层面产生了负网络外部性。由于市场进入通过事务所拆分实现，这些利润在长期内得以维持。
title: Conflicts of interest, ethical standards, and competition in legal services†
title_zh: 法律服务中的利益冲突、道德标准与竞争

abstract: Recent research documents the growing frequency of land-use conflicts in rural areas. As conflicts between farmers and other stakeholders intensify while farmland resources continue to decline, spatial planning and the legal protection of agricultural land have become key policy priorities. This makes understanding farmers’ preferences regarding neighboring land uses particularly important. However, quantitative evidence remains limited. To address this gap, we used a discrete choice experiment to examine farmers’ perceptions of potentially conflict-generating neighboring land uses in a sample of 960 farmers from the Warmińsko-Mazurskie voivodeship, Poland. The results show that residential and business activities, especially when conducted at a large scale, are perceived as the most conflict-generating types of neighboring land uses. However, farmers’ perceptions vary across farm characteristics and locations. Residential neighborhoods are perceived as particularly conflict-generating by livestock farmers and farmers in highly urbanized municipalities, while patterns by farm size and nature-protection status are less consistent.
abstract_zh: 近期研究记录了农村地区土地利用冲突日益频繁的现象。随着农民与其他利益相关者之间的冲突不断加剧，而耕地资源持续减少，空间规划与农地法律保护已成为关键政策优先事项。这使得理解农民对相邻土地利用的偏好尤为重要。然而，定量证据仍然有限。为填补这一空白，我们采用离散选择实验，以波兰瓦尔米亚-马祖里省960名农民为样本，考察了农民对可能引发冲突的相邻土地利用的感知。结果表明，住宅和商业活动，尤其是大规模开展时，被视为最具冲突性的相邻土地利用类型。然而，农民的感知因农场特征和区位而异。畜牧养殖户以及高度城市化市镇的农民认为住宅邻接尤其容易引发冲突，而农场规模和自然保护状态方面的模式则较不一致。
title: Farmers’ perceptions of conflict-prone neighborhoods – Insights from a choice experiment
title_zh: 农民对冲突多发社区的感知——来自选择实验的见解

abstract: This paper examines how global commodity price shocks propagate through resource-dependent economies, with a focus on the interaction between extraction costs and domestic policy responses. We develop a simple framework in which high-cost producers are more exposed to negative price shocks, but the persistence of their response depends on investment conditions and policy environments. We test these predictions using the 2014–2016 oil price collapse, comparing Alberta—one of the world’s highest-cost oil producers—to a synthetic control constructed from lower-cost jurisdictions. Alberta experienced significantly larger declines in hydrocarbon output, investment, and per capita GDP, along with a more prolonged recovery. However, placebo analyses for other high-cost jurisdictions reveal no comparable declines, indicating that cost structure alone is insufficient to explain the observed contraction. Exploiting within-province variation, we further show that Alberta’s response to the 2015 shock differs markedly from its response to the 2009 collapse, despite an unchanged cost structure. Event-study estimates indicate that the post-2015 decline is closely associated with contemporaneous fiscal policy changes. While policy responses may be endogenous, the combined evidence points to a transmission mechanism in which domestic policy shapes—and potentially amplifies—the effects of external shocks in high-cost environments.
abstract_zh: 本文考察全球商品价格冲击如何通过资源依赖型经济体传导，重点关注开采成本与国内政策应对之间的相互作用。我们构建了一个简单框架，其中高成本生产商更容易受到负面价格冲击的影响，但其反应的持续性取决于投资条件和政策环境。我们利用2014—2016年油价暴跌检验这些预测，将阿尔伯塔——全球成本最高的石油生产地之一——与由较低成本辖区构建的合成控制组进行比较。阿尔伯塔在油气产量、投资和人均GDP方面经历了显著更大的下降，且复苏更为漫长。然而，对其他高成本辖区的安慰剂分析并未显示出可比程度的下降，这表明仅凭成本结构不足以解释所观察到的收缩。利用省内变异，我们进一步表明，尽管成本结构未变，阿尔伯塔对2015年冲击的反应与对2009年暴跌的反应存在显著差异。事件研究估计表明，2015年后的下降与同期财政政策变化密切相关。尽管政策应对可能具有内生性，但综合证据指向一种传导机制，即国内政策在高成本环境中塑造——并可能放大——外部冲击的影响。
title: Shock amplification and delayed recovery in resource economies: The role of fiscal policy reform
title_zh: 资源型经济中的冲击放大与延迟复苏：财政政策改革的作用

abstract: Drawing on a Post-Keynesian framework, this paper examines the impact of minimum wage increases on inflation, unemployment rate, demand, and the trade balance in Türkiye, a country characterized by persistent high inflation. Using monthly data from 2005 to 2024 and Structural Vector Autoregression (SVAR) models, we analyze the relationships between minimum wage adjustments, consumer prices, unemployment, capacity utilization, and trade balance. Our findings indicate that a 10% increase in the minimum wage raises annual inflation by 1.0-2.0 percentage points. This inflationary effect is primarily driven by the cost channel, as opposed to the demand channel. The analysis finds no significant evidence that minimum wage increases influence demand-side factors such as capacity utilization, industrial growth, or retail sales. The impact on unemployment is minimal —0.10 to 0.15 percentage points. Moreover, a 10% rise in the minimum wage generates an extra trade deficit amounting to 0.11–0.27% of GDP.
abstract_zh: 本文基于后凯恩斯主义框架，考察最低工资上涨对土耳其这一以持续高通胀为特征国家在通货膨胀、失业率、需求及贸易平衡方面的影响。我们使用2005年至2024年的月度数据和结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型，分析最低工资调整、消费者价格、失业、产能利用率与贸易平衡之间的关系。研究发现，最低工资上涨10%会使年度通货膨胀率上升1.0至2.0个百分点。这一通胀效应主要由成本渠道驱动，而非需求渠道。分析未发现显著证据表明最低工资上涨会影响产能利用率、工业增长或零售销售等需求侧因素。对失业的影响极小——为0.10至0.15个百分点。此外，最低工资上涨10%会额外产生相当于GDP的0.11%至0.27%的贸易逆差。
title: Minimum Wages in a High-Inflation Economy: The case of Türkiye
title_zh: 高通胀经济中的最低工资：土耳其案例

abstract: This paper studies how litigation and settlement behaviour is affected by agents motivated by spiteful preferences under the American fee‐shifting rule compared to the English one. We conduct an experiment and find that litigation expenditures are overall higher under the English rule compared to the American rule—even for low‐merit cases—while there is no difference for settlement requests. Spiteful participants exhibit overall higher expenditures and settlement requests, with a more pronounced increase in litigation expenditures under the American fee‐shifting rule and a similar increase in settlement requests under both rules. Being spiteful comes at a cost. The expected payoff is lower for more spiteful litigants—especially under the American rule—independent of facing a less or more spiteful opponent. Additionally, being matched with a more spiteful litigant reduces the expected payoff similarly under both rules. We conclude that the English rule can protect spiteful players from themselves but cannot reduce the harm they inflict upon others—at the cost of inducing higher litigation expenditures for less spiteful players compared to the American rule.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在美式费用转移规则与英式费用转移规则下，受恶意偏好驱动的代理人的诉讼与和解行为如何受到影响。我们开展了一项实验，发现相较于美式规则，英式规则下诉讼支出总体上更高——即使对于低胜诉可能性的案件也是如此——而在和解请求方面则没有差异。恶意参与者总体上表现出更高的支出与和解请求，其中在美式费用转移规则下诉讼支出的增加更为显著，而在两种规则下和解请求的增加幅度相似。怀有恶意是有代价的。对于恶意程度更高的诉讼当事人而言，预期收益更低——尤其是在美式规则下——无论其面对的是恶意程度更低还是更高的对手。此外，与恶意程度更高的诉讼当事人配对，在两种规则下都会以相似方式降低预期收益。我们得出结论：英式规则能够保护恶意参与者使其免受自身之害，但无法减少他们对他人造成的伤害——其代价是相较于美式规则，会为恶意程度较低的参与者引致更高的诉讼支出。
title: Spite in litigation
title_zh: 诉讼中的恶意

abstract: We construct a unique micro-level dataset covering the near universe of France's cross-border financial positions and document three novel facts about firms' financial internationalization. First, cross-border financial positions are highly concentrated, substantially more so than international trade. Second, financial internationalization differs sharply across firms: firms in the bottom 90 percentiles only raise foreign funds, whereas the largest firms both invest and raise funds abroad. Third, newly internationalized firms enter primarily by raising foreign equity. These facts reveal two distinct margins of financial internationalization: a funding margin, through which the majority of firms internationalize by only raising foreign equity, and an investment margin, reached only by the largest firms. We develop a heterogeneous-firm model in which domestic financial imperfections make foreign equity valuable, rationalizing these two margins. Empirically, financial internationalization associates with a rebalancing of capital structure away from costly domestic bank debt and an expansion in firms' equity and size. At the macro level, firm heterogeneity matters: the cross-border allocations of the majority of firms are substantially more affected by country-specific factors than aggregate estimates suggest, because these positions disproportionately reflect the allocations of the largest firms, whose cross-border activities span worldwide largely independently of country characteristics.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个独特的微观层面数据集，覆盖了法国跨境金融头寸的近乎全体样本，并记录了关于企业金融国际化的三个新事实。第一，跨境金融头寸高度集中，其集中程度显著高于国际贸易。第二，金融国际化在不同企业之间差异显著：位于后90百分位的企业仅从国外筹集资金，而规模最大的企业既在海外投资又在海外筹资。第三，新实现国际化的企业主要通过筹集外国股权进入国际市场。这些事实揭示了金融国际化的两个不同边际：一个是融资边际，大多数企业通过仅筹集外国股权来实现国际化；另一个是投资边际，只有规模最大的企业才能达到。我们构建了一个异质性企业模型，其中本国金融不完善使外国股权具有价值，从而为这两个边际提供了合理化解释。在实证上，金融国际化与资本结构从成本高昂的国内银行债务转向其他融资方式以及企业股权和规模的扩张相关。在宏观层面，企业异质性至关重要：大多数企业的跨境配置受国别特定因素的影响远大于总体估计所显示的程度，因为这些头寸不成比例地反映了最大企业的配置，而最大企业的跨境活动遍布全球，在很大程度上独立于国家特征。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为法国跨境金融配置与法国企业，数据与制度背景均为法国，不涉及中国。
title: Heterogeneous Cross-Border Financial Allocations
title_zh: 异质性跨境金融配置

abstract: We propose the Generalized Karenina Principle as a decision rationale for allocating a finite resource among essential requirements. Beyond competing for resources, requirements may be contradictory: gratifying one can directly impair another. Maximizing a multiplicative measure of success yields an adaptive rule that restores the optimal balance among gratification levels. In the two-requirement model, interior Karenina-optimal allocation remains locally stable as contradiction increases, whereas needresponsive allocation can generate destabilizing overcompensation. With interacting decision makers, Karenina-optimal reallocation also raises the threshold for collective instability. The principle bases adaptive allocation on restoring optimal gratification ratios rather than responding to individual deficits.
abstract_zh: 我们提出广义卡列尼娜原则，作为在若干基本需求之间分配有限资源的决策依据。除争夺资源外，各项需求还可能相互矛盾：满足其中一项可能直接损害另一项。最大化一种乘法式成功度量，会得到一种自适应规则，从而在各项满足水平之间恢复最优平衡。在双需求模型中，随着矛盾加剧，内部的卡列尼娜最优分配仍保持局部稳定，而需求响应式分配则可能产生破坏稳定性的过度补偿。在决策者相互作用的条件下，卡列尼娜最优再分配还会提高集体不稳定的阈值。该原则将自适应分配建立在恢复最优满足比例之上，而非对单项亏缺作出响应。
title: The Karenina Principle: A Decision Rule for Contradicting Requirements
title_zh: 卡列尼娜原则：矛盾需求的决策规则

abstract: Standard macroeconomic theories assume that representative or heterogeneous agents share a common model of how the economy operates. Yet evidence shows that households hold heterogeneous subjective models-distinct beliefs about how macroeconomic variables interact. As a result, identical shocks or policies may elicit different responses from otherwise similar households. We test this hypothesis by measuring subjective models and investigating their role in the transmission of monetary policy to consumption embedding randomized controlled experiment in a large-scale, multi-country survey. Consumers who believe that monetary tightening primarily operates through its effects on borrowing or savings rates plan to reduce consumption more in response to randomly assigned rate increase scenarios. By contrast, those who think about inflation or general equilibrium effects adjust consumption less. These differences are not explained by demographics, financial characteristics, including mortgage holdings and mortgage type, or country-level factors. Households’ actual consumption responses to endogenous policy-rate changes exhibit broadly similar patterns. Our findings stress that heterogeneity in subjective models is an overlooked determinant of monetary policy transmission.
abstract_zh: 标准宏观经济理论假设，代表性或异质性主体共享一个关于经济如何运行的共同模型。然而，证据表明，家庭持有异质性的主观模型——即关于宏观经济变量如何相互作用的不同信念。因此，相同的冲击或政策可能引发原本相似家庭的不同反应。我们通过在一项大规模、多国调查中嵌入随机对照实验，测量主观模型并考察其在货币政策向消费传导中的作用，来检验这一假说。认为货币紧缩主要通过其对借贷利率或储蓄利率的影响发挥作用的消费者，在随机分配的加息情景下计划更多地削减消费。相比之下，那些考虑通胀效应或一般均衡效应的消费者则较少调整消费。这些差异无法由人口统计特征、金融特征（包括抵押贷款持有情况和抵押贷款类型）或国家层面因素解释。家庭对内生政策利率变化的实际消费反应也呈现出大体相似的模式。我们的发现强调，主观模型的异质性是货币政策传导中被忽视的决定因素。
title: Subjective Models of the Macroeconomy and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
title_zh: 宏观经济的主观模型与货币政策传导

abstract: Why is there so much wage inequality within occupations? Why has the overall level of within-occupation wage inequality risen? Why is the rise concentrated in cognitive-intensive occupations, while inequality has fallen in manual-intensive ones? To answer these questions we develop a general equilibrium model with heterogeneous workers who supply multiple skills jointly, as an indivisible bundle. This bundling friction allows a given skill to be priced differently in different occupations. We find in US data that differences in skill prices, not worker composition, explain why within-occupation inequality is higher in more cognitively intensive occupations and account for about a third of the rise in within-occupation inequality from 1980 to 2010. We show that a uniform increase in the productivity of cognitive skill can drive inequality up in cognitive-intensive occupations and down in manual ones, just as in the data.
abstract_zh: 为什么职业内部的工资不平等如此严重？为什么职业内部工资不平等的总体水平上升了？为什么这种上升集中在认知密集型职业，而体力密集型职业的不平等却下降了？为回答这些问题，我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，其中异质性工人以不可分割的捆绑方式共同供给多种技能。这种捆绑摩擦使得同一技能在不同职业中可以被赋予不同的价格。我们在美国数据中发现，技能价格的差异——而非工人构成——解释了为什么认知密集度更高的职业内部不平等更高，并解释了1980年至2010年间职业内部不平等上升的约三分之一。我们表明，认知技能生产率的统一提高可以推动认知密集型职业的不平等上升、体力密集型职业的不平等下降，正如数据中所呈现的那样。
title: Unbundling Labor
title_zh: 劳动力解绑

abstract: This paper examines innovation outcomes before and after 1,200 startup acquisitions by eight major technology firms. Linking patent and workforce data to these deals, we document four main findings. First, most acquired startups hold no patents, but those with patents tend to operate in technology areas where the acquirer already has a presence and that see further acquisition activity. Second, innovation typically rises before an acquisition, continues afterward only where further acquisitions follow, and falls back once acquisition activity ends. We propose a stylized model in which beliefs about commercial viability drive both startup entry and acquisitions to explain how these patterns arise through selection rather than effects of the deals. Third, acquired patents receive significantly more citations after the acquisition than comparable patents, not only from the acquirer but also from firms that hire the targets’ employees. Fourth, although 31% of employees and 23% of inventors depart within a year, inventors who stay go on to patent substantially more, while stayers and leavers were equally productive beforehand. In the aggregate, we find little evidence that acquisitions by digital incumbents suppress innovation, even though serial acquisitions go hand in hand with growing patent consolidation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了八家大型科技公司进行的1200起初创企业收购前后的创新结果。通过将专利与劳动力数据同这些交易相连接，我们记录了四项主要发现。第一，大多数被收购的初创企业不持有专利，但那些持有专利的企业往往经营于收购方已有布局、且后续仍有收购活动的技术领域。第二，创新通常在收购前上升，仅在后续仍有收购发生时才会在收购后延续，而一旦收购活动结束便回落。我们提出一个风格化模型，其中对商业可行性的信念同时驱动初创企业进入与收购，以解释这些模式如何通过选择而非交易效应产生。第三，被收购专利在收购后获得的引用显著多于可比专利，不仅来自收购方，也来自雇佣目标企业员工的公司。第四，尽管31%的员工和23%的发明人在一年内离职，留下来的发明人随后申请的专利大幅增加，而留下者与离职者在此前同样高产。总体而言，我们几乎没有发现证据表明数字在位企业的收购抑制了创新，尽管连续收购与日益加剧的专利集中相伴而行。
title: Digital (Killer?) Acquisitions
title_zh: 数字（杀手？）收购

abstract: Analyses of impacts of potential mergers in differentiated product markets often rely on non-transparent identification and strong conduct assumptions. We propose a simpler alternative: using quasi-exogenous variation in market structure to estimate equilibrium pricing policy functions. When price can appropriately capture consumer welfare, this methodology may require fewer assumptions than a structural equilibrium approach, including allowing variation in conduct. We apply this methodology to the JetBlue–Spirit merger, estimating policy functions using entry events. Our counterfactual price simulations account for changes in JetBlue’s capacity and Sprit’s elimination. The merger would cause $2.6 billion in annual harm under our preferred specification.
abstract_zh: 对差异化产品市场中潜在合并影响的分析，往往依赖于不透明的识别方法和强行为假设。我们提出一种更简单的替代方法：利用市场结构的准外生变化来估计均衡定价策略函数。当价格能够适当反映消费者福利时，相较于结构性均衡方法，该方法可能所需假设更少，包括允许行为发生变化。我们将该方法应用于捷蓝航空与精神航空的合并，利用进入事件估计策略函数。我们的反事实价格模拟考虑了捷蓝航空运力的变化以及精神航空的退出。在我们偏好的设定下，该合并将造成每年26亿美元的损害。
title: Using Policy Functions to Estimate Merger Impacts: An Application to JetBlue-Spirit
title_zh: 使用政策函数估计合并影响：以捷蓝航空-精神航空为例

abstract: Do stimulus checks—one-off, deficit-financed lump-sum payments to households—boost the economy? We study a natural experiment: payments to U.S. veterans after World War II that mimic stimulus checks but were plausibly exogenous to the economy. These payments led to a temporary increase in transfers and a persistent, hump-shaped increase in consumption. The transfer multiplier—the cumulative response of consumption to transfers—reaches 1 after six months and exceeds 2 after a year. The standard heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian model cannot match the hump-shaped consumption response. A version with imperfect expectations—with households underreacting on impact but overreacting at longer horizons—can match our estimates.
abstract_zh: 一次性、由赤字融资的定额支付给家庭的刺激支票能否提振经济？我们研究了一个自然实验：二战后向美国退伍军人支付的款项，其形式类似于刺激支票，但与经济状况 plausibly 外生。这些支付导致转移支付的暂时增加，以及消费的持续、驼峰形增长。转移乘数——消费对转移支付的累积响应——在六个月后达到1，一年后超过2。标准异质性主体新凯恩斯模型无法匹配驼峰形的消费响应。一个具有不完全预期的版本——家庭在冲击当期反应不足，但在较长时期反应过度——能够匹配我们的估计。
title: The Macroeconomic Effect of Stimulus Checks: Evidence from Postwar Veterans’ Payments
title_zh: 刺激支票的宏观经济效应：来自战后退伍军人支付款的证据

abstract: We study how the U.S.-China trade war has reshaped global trade patterns, creating significant spillovers to third countries. Using recent tariff policy changes and monthly international trade flow data, we document a redirection of Chinese exports away from the U.S. market and toward third countries. To interpret the impact of these reallocations on third countries, we introduce a taxonomy that separates four exposure margins - export competition, import competition, consumer gains, and sourcing gains - and construct theoretically-derived indices that map countries into these channels. Recent work often proxies such exposure with trade-basket similarity. We show why this can be problematic: similarity measures are symmetric and omit the size of product-specific shocks, Chinese market penetration, substitution elasticities, and incidence weights. Our model-based indices therefore generate country rankings that differ substantially from conventional similarity measures.
abstract_zh: 我们研究美中贸易战如何重塑全球贸易格局，并对第三国产生显著溢出效应。利用近期的关税政策变化和月度国际贸易流量数据，我们记录了中国出口从美国市场转向第三国的重新定向。为解释这些再分配对第三国的影响，我们引入一个分类框架，将四个暴露边际——出口竞争、进口竞争、消费者收益和采购收益——区分开来，并构建理论推导的指数，将各国映射到这些渠道中。近期研究常以贸易篮子相似度来代理此类暴露。我们说明这为何可能存在问题：相似度指标是对称的，且忽略了产品特定冲击的规模、中国市场渗透率、替代弹性以及归属权重。因此，我们基于模型的指数所生成的国家排名与传统相似度指标存在显著差异。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The Remains of the Trade: The U.S.–China Trade War and its Aftermath
title_zh: 贸易的余波：美中贸易战及其后果

abstract: We study the value of informal care from a spouse and how access to such care shapes optimal insurance coverage for long-term care. Using Medicare claims and a novel spousal crosswalk, we examine how the sudden incapacitation of a spouse affects their partner's use of formal care. A spouse's health shock increases their partner's probability of a nursing-home stay by 30%. We document significant negative health effects for the partner, but provide evidence that their increase in nursing-home stays is largely driven by substitution from informal care to formal care. When their partners are incapacitated, Medicare recipients become less sensitive to the price of formal care, consistent with a higher valuation of that care and reduced moral hazard. We develop a framework to interpret these findings. The framework translates differences in the level and price elasticity of demand for formal care into a lower-bound estimate of the value of informal care provided by a spouse. It also suggests that optimal insurance for long-term care should be designed at the household level with more generous coverage for those who do not have access to informal care.
abstract_zh: 我们研究配偶提供的非正式照护的价值，以及获得此类照护如何影响长期护理的最优保险覆盖。利用Medicare理赔数据和一个新颖的配偶交叉匹配方法，我们考察配偶突然失能如何影响其伴侣对正式照护的使用。配偶的健康冲击使其伴侣入住养老院的概率提高30%。我们记录了伴侣显著的健康负面效应，但有证据表明其养老院入住增加在很大程度上是由非正式照护向正式照护的替代所驱动。当伴侣失能时，Medicare受益人对正式照护价格的敏感度降低，这与对正式照护更高估值和道德风险降低相一致。我们构建了一个框架来解释这些发现。该框架将正式照护需求水平和价格弹性的差异转化为对配偶所提供非正式照护价值的下界估计。它还表明，长期护理的最优保险应在家庭层面进行设计，对无法获得非正式照护的人提供更慷慨的覆盖。
title: The Protective Effects of a Healthy Spouse: Medicare as the Family Member of Last Resort
title_zh: 健康配偶的保护作用：医疗保险作为家庭成员的最后依靠

abstract: We study how aggregate financial conditions shape firm insurance and, through it, labor income risk. In a directed search model with dynamic wage contracts and two-sided limited commitment, firm insurance against idiosyncratic shocks erodes when risk premia rise. Using U.S. administrative data, we document new evidence supporting the model: pass-through of firm shocks to earnings rises in bad times, especially for lower-paid workers near the separation margin. The model reproduces many untargeted time-series and cross-sectional features of earnings risk and implies substantial welfare costs of idiosyncratic risk, high private discount rates on human capital, and large gains from recession-contingent transfers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究总体金融状况如何塑造企业保险，并由此影响劳动收入风险。在一个包含动态工资合约和双边有限承诺的定向搜寻模型中，当风险溢价上升时，企业对特质性冲击的保险会削弱。利用美国行政数据，我们记录了支持该模型的新证据：企业冲击向收入的传导在景气不佳时上升，尤其是对接近离职边际的低薪工人而言。该模型再现了收入风险的许多未目标化的时间序列和横截面特征，并意味着特质性风险带来可观的福利成本、人力资本的高私人贴现率，以及衰退 contingent 转移支付带来的巨大收益。
title: Risk Premia, Firm Insurance, and Endogenous Labor Income Risk
title_zh: 风险溢价、企业保险与内生劳动收入风险

abstract: Governments have long imposed minimum equity requirements on new corporations. Opponents view them as barriers to entry while proponents argue that they protect stakeholders from financially unviable businesses. We study this quantity-quality trade-off using a Norwegian reform and comprehensive data linking entrepreneurs to their firms. A 70% reduction in required capital nearly doubled entrepreneurial entry, with no deterioration in survival, profitability, productivity, or interest-bearing leverage and no differences in founders’ ex-ante income, liquidity, or ability. These results suggest capital requirements restrict entrepreneurship without screening on quality or liquidity. Rather, we highlight returns-to-scale heterogeneity as an important determinant of the observed entry response.
abstract_zh: 政府长期对新设公司施加最低股权要求。反对者将其视为进入壁垒，而支持者则认为其能保护利益相关者免受财务上不可持续企业之害。我们利用一项挪威改革以及将创业者与其企业相链接的全面数据，研究这一数量与质量之间的权衡。所需资本降低70%使创业进入几乎翻倍，而存活率、盈利能力、生产率或有息杠杆均未恶化，创始人在事前收入、流动性或能力方面也无差异。这些结果表明，资本要求限制了创业，却并未对质量或流动性进行筛选。相反，我们强调规模收益异质性是可观察到的进入反应的重要决定因素。
title: Regulating Entrepreneurship: The Case of Capital Requirements
title_zh: 规制创业活动：资本要求案例

abstract: We consider official and alternative data sources for measuring and projecting the role of U.S. manufacturing in the global semiconductor manufacturing industry. We find that the government sources we consider face significant limitations for tracking semiconductor fab investment in real time: they use industry and product categories that are too broad and come with substantial publication lags. We then analyze project-level alternative data from Semiconductor Equipment and Materials International (SEMI), which provides quarterly tracking of individual fab projects with greater timeliness and specificity. Comparing SEMI data with official statistics through 2023, we find broad consistency in investment levels, validating SEMI as a credible supplement to official statistics. This work provides both a practical guide for tracking real-time trends in semiconductor manufacturing and a case study in synthesizing government and alternative data sources.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了用于衡量和预测美国制造业在全球半导体制造业中所起作用的官方与替代数据来源。我们发现，所考虑的政府数据来源在实时追踪半导体晶圆厂投资方面存在显著局限：它们使用的行业和产品分类过于宽泛，且伴随严重的发布滞后。随后，我们分析了来自国际半导体设备与材料协会（SEMI）的项目级替代数据，该数据以更高的及时性和具体性对单个晶圆厂项目进行季度追踪。将SEMI数据与截至2023年的官方统计数据进行比较，我们发现投资水平总体一致，验证了SEMI作为官方统计可信补充的价值。本研究既为追踪半导体制造业实时趋势提供了实用指南，也提供了综合政府与替代数据来源的案例研究。
title: Measuring and Projecting U.S. Investment in Semiconductor Manufacturing Capacity
title_zh: 衡量与预测美国半导体制造产能投资

abstract: We study whether investor voice can help address global externalities under fragmented regulation. In our setting, a multinational firm generates externalities across jurisdictions, national regulators face political frictions that can impede corrective regulation, and policy differences create scope for regulatory arbitrage and production leakage. We compare two channels of investor influence: corporate stewardship, which affects firms’ global operations, and policy advocacy, which affects local regulation. Both channels can help address global externalities, but their relative effectiveness depends on political frictions abroad. When these frictions are severe enough to prevent foreign regulation, leakage weakens policy advocacy but strengthens stewardship. When foreign regulation is politically feasible, however, stewardship can crowd out foreign regulation and reinforce policy miscoordination, while local policy advocacy can crowd in foreign regulation and reduce externalities abroad.
abstract_zh: 我们研究在监管碎片化背景下，投资者发声能否有助于解决全球外部性问题。在我们的设定中，一家跨国公司会在不同司法管辖区产生外部性，各国监管机构面临可能阻碍纠正性监管的政治摩擦，而政策差异则为监管套利和生产转移创造了空间。我们比较了投资者影响的两种渠道：公司督导，其影响企业的全球运营；以及政策倡导，其影响地方监管。两种渠道都有助于解决全球外部性，但其相对有效性取决于国外的政治摩擦。当这些摩擦严重到足以阻止外国监管时，泄漏会削弱政策倡导，但会强化公司督导。然而，当外国监管在政治上可行时，公司督导可能挤出外国监管并加剧政策不协调，而地方政策倡导则可能挤入外国监管并减少国外外部性。
title: Governing Global Externalities: Investor Voice Amid Fragmented Policy
title_zh: 治理全球外部性：政策碎片化中的投资者声音

abstract: We discuss how immigration affects identity, with implications for politics. We build on key insights from social psychology and their formalization in economics to derive predictions about how immigration changes both self-identification and categorization of others into groups. These immigration-induced identity changes can explain two recent political transformations that have characterized many Western democracies: the rise of right-wing populism and the realignment of voters and parties along a socio-cultural, rather than economic, dimension of political conflict. We also discuss how immigration can reshape group boundaries and political cleavages, depending on the characteristics of immigrants, host populations, and the local context. We highlight open questions and possible directions for future research.
abstract_zh: 我们讨论移民如何影响身份认同，并由此对政治产生影响。我们基于社会心理学的关键洞见及其在经济学中的形式化，推导出关于移民如何改变自我认同以及如何将他人归类为群体的预测。这些由移民引发的身份认同变化，可以解释近年来许多西方民主国家出现的两种政治转变：右翼民粹主义的兴起，以及选民和政党沿着社会文化维度而非经济维度的政治冲突重新组合。我们还讨论移民如何重塑群体边界和政治分野，这取决于移民、东道国人口以及当地情境的特征。我们强调尚未解决的问题以及未来研究的可能方向。
title: Migration, Identity and Political Economy in a Globalizing World
title_zh: 全球化世界中的移民、身份与政治经济

abstract: We examine whether early exposure to the teaching career has the potential to expand the size and diversity of new teacher supply. Exploiting the staggered expansion of high school education courses across Texas, we find little evidence that these courses increased new teacher supply or diversity despite course takers being substantially more diverse than the teacher workforce. High school education course takers who become teachers are similarly effective and more likely to be retained than their peers. Most course takers drop out of the teacher pipeline prior to college enrollment where racial gaps in 4-year college going serve as major barriers. Our findings suggest that early exposure without support to increase college going is unlikely to increase teacher supply or diversity.
abstract_zh: 我们考察早期接触教学职业是否有可能扩大新教师供给的规模与多样性。利用德克萨斯州高中教育课程错峰推广这一准自然实验，我们发现几乎没有证据表明这些课程增加了新教师供给或多样性，尽管选课学生在构成上远比现有教师队伍更为多元。在选课学生中最终成为教师者，其教学效能与同行相当，且更有可能留任。大多数选课学生在进入大学之前就退出了教师培养通道，而四年制大学入学中的种族差距构成了主要障碍。我们的研究结果表明，若缺乏旨在提高大学入学率的配套支持，仅靠早期接触不太可能增加教师供给或多样性。
title: Can Early Exposure to the Teaching Profession Increase Teacher Supply and Diversity? New Evidence on the Teacher Pipeline
title_zh: 早期接触教师职业能否增加教师供给和多样性？关于教师培养路径的新证据

abstract: We investigate how limiting interest deductibility under the 2017 TCJA shapes corporate innovation. Using alternative identification strategies, we show that, relative to unaffected firms, affected firms experience significant declines in patenting and narrow the technological scope of their patent portfolios. This contraction is concentrated in exploitative patents, the type of innovation most naturally supported by debt financing. By weakening firms’ ability to finance innovation with long-term debt, interest limitations reveal a novel channel linking taxation to innovation, with the debt tax shield serving as an implicit subsidy. Cross-country evidence from the staggered implementation of interest limitation rules confirms negative effects.
abstract_zh: 我们考察2017年《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）下限制利息可扣除性如何影响企业创新。通过采用多种替代性识别策略，我们发现，相对于未受影响的企业，受影响企业的专利产出显著下降，且其专利组合的技术范围收窄。这种收缩集中在开发性专利上，而这类创新最自然地依赖债务融资支持。利息限制削弱了企业以长期债务为创新融资的能力，从而揭示出一条将税收与创新联系起来的新渠道，其中债务税盾发挥隐性补贴的作用。来自利息限制规则交错实施国家的跨国证据也证实了负向效应。
title: When Tax Shields Shrink: Interest Deductibility Limitations and Corporate Innovation
title_zh: 当税盾缩水：利息扣除限制与企业创新

abstract: How big are the gains to international migration? How do they vary across migrants? We study these questions using linked administrative data for Austria and Germany, focusing on migrants who were steadily employed 2-4 years before their move and using their previous co-workers as a comparison group for a difference-in-differences design. We combine data from the origin and destination countries for 5 years after the move, allowing us to assess the gains for those who remain in the destination and those who return. On average, migrants from Austria to Germany experience an immediate and persistent rise of around 13% in their daily wage relative to their matched co-workers, while migrants from Germany to Austria gain about 4%. The higher returns for Austrians are mainly driven by higher average wages in Germany, rather than by differential selection of migrants. Consistent with a dynamic learning model, the returns to migration are largest for migrants who remain in the destination country, smaller for those who return after 1-4 years, and zero or even slightly negative for those who return in less than a year. They are also larger for migrants who follow established cross-border networks between workplaces. To help interpret our findings we conduct a parallel analysis of domestic migrants who move to a larger city (Vienna or one of the 5 largest cities in Germany). “Big city” movers experience gains in wages of about 5% for Austrians and 10% for Germans. Again the gains are largest for those who remain in the destination city, with smaller effects for those who move on.
abstract_zh: 国际移民的收益有多大？这些收益在不同移民之间有何差异？我们利用奥地利和德国的关联行政数据研究这些问题，重点关注在迁移前2至4年稳定就业的移民，并将其此前的同事作为双重差分设计中的对照组。我们合并了迁移后5年来源国和目的国的数据，从而能够评估留在目的国者和返回者的收益。平均而言，从奥地利迁往德国的移民相对于其匹配同事，日工资立即且持续上升约13%，而从德国迁往奥地利的移民则获得约4%的收益。奥地利人更高的回报主要由德国更高的平均工资驱动，而非移民的选择性差异。与动态学习模型一致，留在目的国的移民迁移回报最大，1至4年后返回者较小，而在不到一年内返回者则为零甚至略为负。对于沿着工作场所之间既有跨境网络迁移的移民，回报也更大。为帮助解释我们的发现，我们对迁往更大城市（维也纳或德国5个最大城市之一）的国内移民进行了平行分析。“大城市”迁移者的工资收益约为奥地利人5%、德国人10%。同样，留在目的城市的迁移者收益最大，继续迁移者的效应较小。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为奥地利和德国的国际移民，数据与制度背景均为欧洲，不涉及中国。
title: The Returns to International Migration in a Free Mobility Setting: Evidence from Austria and Germany
title_zh: 自由流动环境下的国际移民回报：来自奥地利和德国的证据

abstract: We show how fertility delays compound across generations to raise age at first grandmotherhood. Under the 1960 first-birth schedule median grandmotherhood came at 44. Under the 2024 schedule it is 57, cutting the healthy years with grandchildren from 28 to 15. Longer life does not make up the loss of years when the grandmother is healthy enough to supply money and care. Delay is most pronounced among the college-educated, with reproductive-control access accounting for over half the fall in grandmotherhood by age 55 among White college graduates. When a daughter times her first birth to maximize her own payoff, the loss her choice imposes on her mother is external to her calculation. We call this the Rotten Adult Kid Problem. Delay raises both the price of a grandmother's care and wealth per grandchild.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了生育延迟如何代际叠加，从而提高初次成为祖母的年龄。在1960年的初育时间表下，成为祖母的中位年龄为44岁。在2024年的时间表下，这一年龄为57岁，使祖母与孙辈共度的健康年数从28年降至15年。更长的寿命并不能弥补祖母健康到足以提供金钱和照护的那些年份的损失。延迟在受过大学教育者中最为显著，在白人大学毕业生中，获得生殖控制手段解释了55岁前成为祖母比例下降的一半以上。当女儿为最大化自身收益而安排自己的初育时间时，她的选择给母亲造成的损失在她的计算之外。我们将此称为“烂成年子女问题”。延迟既提高了祖母照护的价格，也提高了每个孙辈对应的财富。
title: Compound Delay: The Causes and Consequences of Later Grandmotherhood
title_zh: 复合延迟：晚育祖母现象的原因与后果

abstract: A growing body of research shows that excessive heat increases the frequency of heat-related injuries at work. While interest in mitigating occupational risks from excessive heat is high, there is little evidence on whether legislation targeting heat exposure can reduce such injuries. Using a triple-differences approach and administrative data from workers’ compensation systems, we evaluate California’s heat standard – adopted in 2005 - and find that the standard substantially reduces the frequency of work injuries in the construction, agriculture, and transportation industries. The effects increase with outside temperatures and are larger among younger workers. Our findings have clear implications for workplace safety and contribute to ongoing policy debates.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的研究表明，过度高温会增加工作中与高温相关伤害的发生频率。尽管人们对降低过度高温带来的职业风险兴趣浓厚，但关于针对高温暴露的立法能否减少此类伤害，证据仍然很少。我们采用三重差分方法，并使用来自劳动者补偿系统的行政数据，评估了加利福尼亚州于2005年通过的高温标准，发现该标准大幅降低了建筑、农业和运输行业的工作伤害发生频率。其效果随室外温度升高而增强，并且在较年轻劳动者中更为明显。我们的发现对工作场所安全具有明确的启示，并为正在进行的政策讨论提供了依据。
title: Cooler Laws, Safer Workers: Evaluating California’s Heat Standard and Injury Reduction
title_zh: 更凉爽的法律，更安全的工人：评估加州高温标准与伤害减少

abstract: This paper studies the transformation of American life insurance, the largest contractual savings institution in the United States before Social Security. As the market for insurance became national, did control over the savings it collected disperse with it? Using a newly digitized annual firm-by-state panel of premiums and losses covering nearly every U.S. life insurer from 1888 to 1940, I distinguish the geography of collection from the geography of control: where premiums were paid, and where the firms receiving them were domiciled. The industry was remade over these six decades. Real premium income rose more than twentyfold, the number of active insurers grew sixfold, incorporation shifted decisively from the Northeast toward the Midwest and South, and within-state concentration fell by nearly half. Control was rearranged, not dispersed. Chartering domestic insurers raised local retention almost entirely at the extensive margin. Across regions, this closed a large gap, as the Northeast retained nearly eleven times as much of its premium as the South in the 1890s and only twice as much by the 1930s, with nine-tenths of the convergence coming from Southern states acquiring domestic sectors where they had none. The national total held: firms domiciled where premium was raised collected just under a quarter of it in the 1890s and just over a fifth in the 1930s, even as household participation converged steadily across states.
